card.name: Commas before instructed next actions
card.fires_on: The comma right after a 'discontinue [drug]' or 'if X occurs' clause, where a further instruction follows. Also bullets or 'should' that start a directive.

modes.label: Comma after stop instruction
modes.description: Comma after 'discontinue DRUG' or 'if reaction occurs', before a follow-up action.
modes.example: If an overdose occurs, discontinue LIVMARLI<<,>> monitor the patient for any signs and symptoms

modes.label: Directive openers
modes.description: A bullet or 'should' that begins an instruction in a warnings list.

card.writes: It seems to push toward directive wording and away from 'sure'-type and code-comment tokens.
card.plain: It fires where a label tells the reader to stop a drug and then lists what to do next.
